verdict: Maybe, if the evidence is solid. Patch Up pitched vitamin patches that work through the skin on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. The format is novel and convenient, but buyers and doctors will question whether vitamins absorb well through skin, so back your claims with data.
angle: Patches appeal to people who dislike pills and want convenience. The format is new in India, so buyers need education. Keep claims modest, show evidence and target specific needs such as sleep, energy or travel.
